verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product with fix capabilities, so generating a PR from a tracked issue is a fair axis, but no evidence shows it does this. The closest features are adjacent: it checks existing PRs against linked Linear/Jira issue requirements, and it pushes review fixes to an already-open PR branch. Neither creates a pull request from an issue.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
